sup:70610.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

It is always a pleasure to work with you, and we are delighted to present our proposal for your component requirements. As a reliable supply partner, we pride ourselves on delivering excellent service and maintaining a comprehensive product range to keep your production running smoothly. 

For the requested volume, we can offer you a price of €5.74 per unit. This quote comes with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a contract term of 12 months. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We trust this proposal meets your expectations and look forward to continuing our successful business relationship. Please do not hesitate to reach out if you have any questions.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer and for the time your team has put into it.
Thank you for your proposal and for the warm partnership; we appreciate that you have capacity available and are looking to keep your machines working. Our order volume is fixed and represents our full demand for this part over the contract term, with a rising forecast and the planning security of a long-term agreement. Could you review the proposal with your pricing committee in light of this demand and planning security?

Our forecast for this part is up 6.0% (fc:360010@2026-09).
Our forecast for this part is up 15.3% (fc:360011@2026-09).
Our forecast for this part is up 9.0% (fc:360012@2026-09).

On this basis we propose: EUR 4.72 per unit, payment 45 days net, 36 months, for our full demand of 30000 units a year over 36 months.

Could you share your cost breakdown for this part, so we understand the drivers together?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

Dear customer,
Thank you very much for your message - it is always a pleasure to hear from you, and we are glad to help wherever we can.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €5.54 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 36 months.
A few words on this from our side.
We received a lot of material; we looked at what bears on this part.
We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We have already taken that volume change data into account.
We appreciate your positive forecast and the proposal for a 36-month agreement, which offers valuable planning security for both parties.
In return for the extended contract and the 45-day payment terms, we are pleased to offer a revised price of €5.54 per unit.
Regarding your request for a cost breakdown, please understand that as a distributor, our pricing is based on market conditions and our comprehensive service rather than individual manufacturing costs.
Material accounts for about 61 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.
We look forward to doing good business together, and our team is always there for you.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH
